title_en: The Account of the Power of the Name
translit:
|| Ath Shri Nam Pratapni Parchari ||30||

Harakhyo koti brahmandno ray | tene ek motun karyun pasay ||
Antarjami truthya Ram | Vaishnav janne ape tham ||
Bolo santo Hari Parbrahm jay Parbrahm | Swami Padmanabhji tum sharanam ||dhru||

Shri Padmanabhji avatariya jan | odharvane chare khan ||
Vishva tani jene kidhi sar | mukt mehelya nij bhandar ||bolo ||1||

Tilak tulsi mukh Hari nam | sant sangat eh vishram ||
Char padarath to pamiye | jo Vaishnav janne shir namiye ||bolo ||2||

Hari nam tano mahima nahi par | Brahmadik man kare vichar ||
Jotan jotan ladhyun sar | nam ja chhodve bhav sansar ||bolo ||3||

Maha pataki Ajamil joy | te samo bijo nahi koi ||
Putra bhave jene lidhun nam | mukti sarkhun apyun tham ||bolo ||4||

Gunka sarkhi te mugti gai | teni sakh brahmande gai ||
Janma ja chhuti bhav santap | juo Hari nam tano pratap ||bolo ||5||

Dait rup Hiranyakashipu nam | tene Harisu karyo sangram ||
Ochhange lai odharyo veri | ap sarikho karyo Hari ||bolo ||6||

Ravane kehvi bhakti ja kari | Ramchandrani gharuni hari ||
Judh kartan lidhun nam | te jan pamyo Vaikunth dham ||bolo ||7||

Krishna tana dveshi bhupal | Jarasangh Shalva Shishupal ||
Kans Kalayavan mad mod | odhariya apradhi krod ||bolo ||8||

Ambarish anudin poshe pran | tene Krishnane melyun ban ||
Veman betho sur pekhtan | odhariyo Arjun dekhtan ||bolo ||9||

Dhruv Amarish Prahlad vakhan | avichal pad pamya nirvan ||
Bal Vibhishan Narad Shesh | moto mahima namno joy ||bolo ||10||

Vaishnavjan thai dharvun dhyan | sakal santne karo pranam ||
Hari vina jene kidhan dharm | teto jano saghla karm ||bolo ||11||

Kund athavis narke bharya | Vaishnav janke thala karya ||
Sant tanun tyan lagyun vay | chhutya nam tene mahimay ||bolo ||12||

Jap tap tirath jag ja karya | sakal dharam tene acharya ||
Kidhan vrat didhan bahu dan | jene mukh ek Parbrahm nam ||bolo ||13||

Char vedno sar e dhar | Vishnu tanun je nam uchar ||
Sakal shastranun tatva e jan | e nishche hainde man an ||bolo ||14||

Te nar dahya mota jan | jehne dhyan ek Sarangpan ||
Sarav gyan je bhaniye jeh | Ram tano ras mane jeh ||bolo ||15||

Dhan dhan kahiye te nar nar | jehni vani vase Murar ||
Hari kirtan gaye sambhale | te nishche Parbrahmne jai male ||bolo ||16||

Harijan maha mohochhav karo | Hari sabad harakhe ocharo ||
Nam tano jehne adhar | mahare Vaishnavjan parivar ||bolo ||17||

Vishnu vina je dhariye dhyan | te jano saghlun agyan ||
Vishnu vina je bijun dharam | te jano saghlun adharam ||bolo ||18||

Janam kot bhage abhas | te Hari nam teno prakash ||
Niranjan pad pame vas | jehvo Thakor tehvo das ||bolo ||19||

Sant sangat mali Hari gun gav | Parbrahmni vani mukh ocharo ||
Harinun bhajan kari lyo lahav | Vaishnav janno e mahimay ||bolo ||20||

Sant renuka mastak dharo | Parbrahmjinun chintvan karo ||
Nam tano avyo vishvas | Nath bhane Vaishnavno das ||bolo ||21||

|| Iti Shri Nam Pratapni Parchari sampurna ||30||

Iti Shri Adhyarujinan kirtan sampurna
translation:
|| Here begins the Shri Nam Pratapni Parchari - the account of the power of the Name ||30||

Refrain (dhru): The king of a crore of universes rejoiced, and he performed one great act of grace: Ram, the knower of every heart, was pleased, and he grants a place to the Vaishnav (devotee of Vishnu). Say it, saints: Hari Parbrahm, victory to Parbrahm! Swami Padmanabhji, we are in your refuge.

1. Know that Shri Padmanabhji has come down as an avatar to redeem all four kinds of birth; he took care of the world and freely released liberation out of his own treasury.
2. The tilak mark, the tulsi, Hari's name in the mouth, and the company of the saints - this is true rest; the four padarath (four great gains of life) are obtained if we bow our head to the Vaishnav.
3. The greatness of Hari's name has no limit; Brahma and the other gods turn it over in their minds; searching and searching they found the essence: the Name alone releases one from the round of worldly existence.
4. Look at Ajamil, that great sinner - there was no other like him; he uttered the Name meaning only his son, and was given a place equal to liberation.
5. Even such a courtesan went to liberation, and the testimony of it spread through the universe; birth itself was ended, and the torment of worldly existence - see the power of Hari's name.
6. There was a demon named Hiranyakashipu who made war upon Hari; taking that enemy upon his lap Hari redeemed him and made him like himself.
7. What kind of bhakti (devotion) did Ravan practise! He carried off Ramchandra's wife; yet, uttering the Name while he fought, that man attained the abode of Vaikunth.
8. The kings who hated Krishna - Jarasangh, Shalva, Shishupal, Kans, Kalayavan whose pride was broken - crores of such offenders were redeemed.
9. Ambarish nourished his life day after day; he loosed an arrow at Krishna; seated in a celestial chariot while the gods looked on, he was redeemed before Arjun's very eyes.
10. Dhruv, Amarish and Prahlad are praised; they attained the unshakable state and nirvan (final release); Bali, Vibhishan, Narad and Shesh - see how great is the glory of the Name.
11. Become a Vaishnav and hold that in meditation; make obeisance to all the saints; whatever religious duties are done without Hari - know them all to be mere karma (empty action).
12. The twenty-eight cauldrons were filled with hell; the Vaishnavs emptied them out; the breath of the saints touched that place, and by the greatness of the Name they were set free.
13. He has done japa, austerity, pilgrimage and sacrifice, and has practised every religious duty; he has kept the fasts and given much in charity - he who has the one name of Parbrahm on his lips.
14. Hold this to be the essence of the four Vedas: to utter the name of Vishnu; know this to be the truth of all the scriptures - fix this with certainty in heart and mind.
15. Know those men to be wise and great whose meditation is on Sarangpan (Vishnu, bearer of the bow) alone; whatever knowledge we may study - it belongs to the one who tastes the savour of Ram.
16. Blessed, blessed we call that man or woman in whose speech Murari (Krishna) dwells; whoever sings and listens to Hari's kirtan (hymn) will surely go and meet Parbrahm.
17. O people of Hari, hold a great festival; utter Hari's word with joy; those whose support is the Name - the Vaishnav folk - are my own family.
18. Any meditation held on anything other than Vishnu - know it all to be ignorance; any religion other than Vishnu - know it all to be irreligion.
19. The illusion of a crore of births is broken - such is the light of Hari's name; one comes to dwell in the state of Niranjan (the stainless Lord): as the Master is, so is the servant.
20. Meeting in the company of the saints, sing Hari's praises; utter the word of Parbrahm with your mouth; take the profit of it by worshipping Hari - this is the glory of the Vaishnav.
21. Place the dust of the saints' feet upon your head; contemplate Parbrahmji; faith in the Name has come - so says Nath, the servant of the Vaishnavs.

|| Here ends the Shri Nam Pratapni Parchari, complete ||30||

Here end the kirtans of Shri Adhyaruji, complete.
